# Taninwat Kaewpankan

Full-stack Engineer and Creative Developer based in Copenhagen, Denmark.
Personal site: https://taninwatkaewpankan.xyz

## About

Taninwat Kaewpankan (goes by Ice) is a full-stack engineer based in
Copenhagen: React, Next.js, TypeScript and PostgreSQL, from the interface to
the database, and he designs the interfaces he builds.
Originally from Thailand, he moved to Sweden at 16, studied at Uppsala
University (BA Game Design, Master of Social Science in Entrepreneurship), and
now lives in Copenhagen, Denmark.

He builds web products end-to-end (React, TypeScript, Next.js, Node.js) and
keeps delivery on track: shaping product direction, scoping work, and shipping
it himself. He led a 25+ consultant student consultancy as Head of Organization,
and contributes part-time to the early-stage AI startup Trailr AI, where he
owned the product side of a full platform UI/UX redesign.

He's honest about where he stands: his degree is a vocational frontend program,
not a CS degree. What he brings is genuine end-to-end delivery experience:
coordinating simultaneous projects and shipping real products.

## Services

Alongside looking for employment, Ice takes on a small number of freelance
client projects for small businesses, startups, and solo founders.
Details and published price ranges: https://taninwatkaewpankan.xyz/services
Enquiry form: https://taninwatkaewpankan.xyz/contact

- Websites for local businesses (Ice's Stack, a one-person web studio), for
  businesses with no website or one that does not do them justice. In Danish,
  English or Swedish. Every client site is coded by hand; Ice does not build in
  Webflow, Wix or WordPress, and does not redesign existing builder sites (a new
  look means a rebuild in code). He does fix what is broken on any site,
  builder or not. Three tiers:
    · Get found, 3.000–5.000 DKK, typically 1–2 weeks. 3.000 = up to 3 pages
      with the client's own text and photos; 4.000 = up to 5 pages, or Ice
      writes the text with them; 5.000 = 5 pages, a second language and text
      help.
    · Stand out, 9.000–15.000 DKK, typically 2–4 weeks. For businesses where
      the look sells: own visual identity, motion, one signature moment, and an
      editor for the important parts included. Lumina, Saep and Første Lys in
      the Showroom are this tier.
    · Run your business on it, from 15.000 DKK, scoped to the client's budget,
      typically 3–8 weeks. A site with a database behind it (logins, orders,
      an admin page). Booking or a self-edited menu does not need this tier.
    · Add-ons, one price each:
        - Edit the important parts yourself (headline, hero photo, button text,
          hours, prices, a menu or list, an offer banner): 2.500 DKK one-off,
          free to run after. Included in Stand out.
        - A second language, 2.000–3.500 DKK, following the number of pages.
          A professional translation is a separate bill to a bureau.
        - Online booking, an existing tool wired in properly, 3.500 DKK.
        - Taking payment via Stripe (card, MobilePay, Apple/Google Pay), 5.000 DKK.
          Not a full webshop.
        - An extra page, 600 DKK per page.
      A map, a gallery, a contact form and a cookie/privacy page are in every
      build already and are not charged for. Taking payment and anything with
      logins are capabilities Ice has built on his own products (Bevisly,
      MockMate) rather than for a client. He says so rather than implying
      otherwise.
    · Payment terms: half at the start, half at launch.
    · Founding client price: 40% off a whole website for Ice's first 3
      clients, in return for a short testimonial and permission to show the
      site. Ends when the 3 spots are taken.
    · Showroom (https://taninwatkaewpankan.xyz/showroom): sample sites for
      made-up businesses, each with what a site like it costs. Concepts, no
      client.
  What it costs to KEEP: no platform fee. Roughly 100–1.600 DKK a year for the
  domain plus hosting, which fits the Netlify/Vercel free tier or costs
  500–1.500 DKK on a Danish webhotel; about 500–8.000 DKK over five years.
  Self-editing is included in Stand out or a one-off add-on, free to run. The
  client cannot move the layout themselves. Every yearly figure is paid by the
  client directly to their host or registrar, never to Ice, who does not mark
  up other people's invoices.
  All prices are quoted ekskl. moms. He is under the Danish 50.000 kr
  registration threshold, so no moms is added today. State that as a fact if
  asked; it is not a discount or a reason to hire him.
  (Mirrors `vat` in app/data.ts. This file does not interpolate, so update both.)
  Every build includes per-page search setup and Google Business connection,
  setup for AI assistants (common questions answered in quotable form,
  schema.org for the business type, an llms.txt summary file like this one,
  name/address/phone made consistent across the main directories, and a check
  of how AI assistants describe the business at launch), mobile-first
  construction, a performance budget, accessibility basics, an enquiry form
  with a backup delivery path, analytics, and domain and hosting registered in
  the client's name, at every tier.
  Reference build: rachabeautywellness.com, a Danish wellness studio's first
  website, 95+ Lighthouse on first deploy.
- Web App Frontend (5.500 DKK / day, roughly 27.500 DKK a week, typically 3–8
  weeks): a React, Next.js and TypeScript frontend built against an API that
  already exists, for teams that have a backend but not an interface.
- Redesign & Performance Rescue (8.000 – 16.000 DKK, typically 1–3 weeks):
  fixing an existing site that is slow, dated, or invisible on Google, instead
  of rebuilding from zero. On a builder site (WordPress, Wix) this covers fixing
  what is broken; a visual redesign there means a rebuild in code. The written
  audit can be bought alone for 3.500 DKK.

Engagements are fixed-scope by default, with a written price and delivery date
agreed before work starts. Where scope genuinely cannot be pinned down he bills
by the day instead (see Web App Frontend above). He does not refuse time-based
work; a fixed price is simply how a website is sold, because it puts the risk of
overrun on him rather than the client. He does the work himself.
The code, domain and hosting all end up in the client's name. He does not take
on native mobile apps, paid advertising campaigns, redesigns or ongoing
patching of builder sites (those get rebuilt in code), or
large backend-heavy platforms built from nothing.

## Skills

Frontend: React 19, Next.js (App Router), TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, Framer Motion
Coordination & Product: Project Coordination, Product Management, Agile / Scrum,
  Stakeholder Management, Process Design, Workshop Facilitation, Product Thinking
Backend: Node.js, PostgreSQL, Supabase, REST APIs
Tooling: Vitest, Playwright, GitHub Actions, Figma
Approach: Design systems, accessibility, performance

## Projects

- Millennial Consulting (https://www.millennialconsulting.dk): Student-run
  strategy consultancy delivering pro-bono projects in 8-week cycles. Coordinated
  5–6 parallel client projects per cycle across 25+ volunteer consultants; grew
  from Operations Assistant to Operations Manager to Head of Organization.
  Introduced a hybrid Agile/waterfall process that was adopted org-wide, plus a
  lightweight Scrum and Kanban system for internal tracking. Took over budget
  tracking in the final cycle when the finance lead left.
- Trailr AI (https://trailr.ai): Early-stage AI video platform that secured
  enterprise trials with two major Danish media companies. Owned the product side of a full
  UI/UX redesign: benchmarked competitors, set a design direction, and scoped
  ruthlessly to what the existing backend could support, cutting features rather
  than forcing rewrites. Led a click-reduction navigation overhaul in React.
- MockMate (https://mockmate.space): AI mock interview platform: paste a job
  description, answer tailored questions from an AI interviewer, get a structured
  graded report. Owned the product end to end. Next.js, Google Gemini, Prisma,
  AWS Lambda.
- Bevisly (https://bevisly.com): Skill verification platform. Owned end-to-end:
  defined the two-role model, designed row-level-security policies, shipped 8+ AI
  features. React, TypeScript, Supabase, PostgreSQL with row-level security.
- Satoshi Standard (https://satoshi-standard.vercel.app): Bitcoin purchasing power
  dashboard. React, Tailwind, real-time price API, full Vitest test suite.
- Racha Beauty & Wellness (https://rachabeautywellness.com): Commercial site
  built from scratch. 95+ Lighthouse score, measurable local SEO improvement.
